Hello! 👋 Welcome to FinSight – your intelligent trading companion.

I can help you with:
• 📊 Real-time stock prices and market data
• 📰 Latest financial news
• 📚 Trading concepts and how-to guides
• 💼 Portfolio insights

Just ask me anything about the markets!

I'm your FinSight Assistant 🤖 – a powerful AI designed to help you with:

📊 **Market Data**
- Real-time stock prices (NSE/BSE)
- Index tracking (Nifty, Sensex, Bank Nifty)
- Stock information and fundamentals

📰 **Financial News**
- Latest market updates
- Stock-specific news

📚 **Trading Education**
- Order types explained
- Technical analysis basics
- Trading strategies

💬 **Smart Conversations**
- I remember context!
- Ask follow-up questions

Example queries:
- "What's the price of TCS?"
- "How is Nifty doing today?"
- "Explain stop-loss orders"
- "Show me market news"

FinSight is a modern AI-powered financial assistant for retail traders and investors.

We provide:
• Smart market insights using AI
• Real-time price tracking
• Educational content on trading
• Contextual conversations that remember what you asked

Whether you're a beginner or experienced trader, FinSight helps you make informed decisions. 🚀

I'm the FinSight Assistant – your AI-powered financial companion! 🤖

I combine:
• Real-time market data APIs
• Advanced language understanding
• Comprehensive trading knowledge

To give you instant, accurate information about stocks, markets, and trading concepts. Think of me as your personal market analyst who's always available! 😊

Good morning! ☀️ Ready to start your trading day?

I can help you with:
• Pre-market analysis
• Stock price checks
• Market news updates

What would you like to know?
Good afternoon! 🌤️ Markets are in session. How can I assist you today?
Good evening! 🌙 Let's review your day or plan for tomorrow. What would you like to know?
You're welcome! 😊 Happy to help. Feel free to ask anything else about the markets!

Goodbye! 👋 Happy trading! Remember:
• Always use stop-losses
• Never invest more than you can afford to lose
• Stay informed with market news

Come back anytime you need help! 🚀
